title: Max Rebo
description: Max Rebo, namesake of the Max Rebo Band, was a whiz with the red ball jett organ. A small blue Ortolan, Max could always be found on stage, keeping tabs on the band and keeping his eyes on the sleazy clients they played for—especially inside Jabba's Palace. Max and his band played the final performances of Jabba's life, even playing on his sail barge in the minutes before it was destroyed by rebels. Max survived and could be found years later entertaining folks in Mos Espa at Garsa's Sanctuary.
